caption: AI Telephone. An image becomes language. Language becomes an image.
A red umbrella floating above an empty swimming pool at night.
The image depicts a serene night scene with a large red umbrella standing on a brick wall near a body of water...
The image depicts a serene dock extending into a calm body of water, leading towards a red-brick building with a pointed roof...
The image captures a serene waterfront scene at dusk, with a wooden dock extending into a calm body of water...
The image depicts a serene waterfront scene during sunset, with a calm body of water reflecting the vibrant hues of the sky...
The image depicts a vibrant city skyline at sunset, with tall skyscrapers reflecting in a calm body of water...
The image depicts a vibrant city skyline at dusk, with tall buildings illuminated in various colors, including purple, pink, and blue...
What survives the translation? Two models. Separate contexts. A continuous chain.
Concept and visual inspiration: Jake Elwes. Independent implementation.
